_note: Skeleton for docs/skill-version-exemptions.json — this factory's own record of law-file commits whose BODY moved without their `version:` moving, read by tests/test_skill_version_contract.py. Copy it into docs/ (the example itself is never read) and leave `exempt` EMPTY unless you have one, because an entry records a REAL permanent ambiguity. WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: the version contract is upheld forward-only and CANNOT be repaired after the fact — the law says so in terms: 'The historical decouplings are excused and printed as excused, never repaired — a bump written after the fact would be a falsified record rather than a repair. Nothing is backfilled.' A bump-only commit would itself violate the contract's second arm, so a decoupling that reaches history has NO repair space. A gate with no exit is a stop with no andon cord: it stays permanently red and the next lane learns to ignore a red gate, which destroys every other gate's signal. So each decoupling is recorded here as VISIBLE DEBT, printed as an `excused:` line on EVERY run, and the closing line distinguishes clean from excused. Every entry names the commit it excuses and the law file whose version stopped tracking its bytes. WHAT IT COSTS, stated so the entry is not read as forgiveness: a lane holding the frozen version cannot tell which of the two bodies it has, and that ambiguity is permanent. Each entry has four REQUIRED fields: `sha` (the FULL 40-character commit id, copied from live git output and never abbreviated), `path` (the law file that was not bumped), `granted` (the date the debt was recorded, ISO-8601), `reason` (what happened), and `proof` (the external receipt that admits it — normally the ledger row number that records the finding). An entry that matches NO problem in the window is a gate ERROR rather than a silent pass, because a stale entry inflates the visible debt while excusing nothing. An absent file means this factory has recorded none; a file that exists and cannot be READ is a reported problem, because only the silent failure is the hazard.
